SELECT TOP 20 a.[PlaqueNumber], a.[Title], MAX(at.[ActivityDate]) AS LatestTransactionDate
FROM [AST].[Asset] AS a
INNER JOIN [AST].[AssetTransaction] AS at ON at.[AssetRef] = a.[AssetId]
GROUP BY a.[PlaqueNumber], a.[Title]
ORDER BY LatestTransactionDate DESC

SELECT TOP 20 b.[Title], COUNT(a.[BankAccountId]) AS AccountCount
FROM [RPA].[BankAccount] AS a
JOIN [RPA].[BankBranch] AS b ON a.[BankBranchRef] = b.[BankBranchId]
GROUP BY b.[Title]
ORDER BY AccountCount DESC

SELECT TOP 20 ba.AccountNo, ba.Balance AS CurrentBalance, bab.Balance AS HistoricalBalance
FROM [RPA].[BankAccount] ba
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT b1.BankAccountRef, b1.Balance
    FROM [RPA].[BankAccountBalance] b1
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT BankAccountRef, MAX(FiscalYearRef) AS MaxFiscalYear
        FROM [RPA].[BankAccountBalance]
        GROUP BY BankAccountRef
    ) b2 ON b1.BankAccountRef = b2.BankAccountRef AND b1.FiscalYearRef = b2.MaxFiscalYear
) bab ON ba.BankAccountId = bab.BankAccountRef
ORDER BY ba.AccountNo ASC

FROM [RPA].[PettyCash] AS pc

Show the top 20 sales invoices in the Sales (SLS) module with the highest total item net price, including the invoice number and customer name. Break ties by invoice ID ascending

response.content:
SELECT TOP 20 i.[Number] AS InvoiceNumber, i.[CustomerRealName] AS CustomerName, SUM(ii.[NetPrice]) AS TotalItemNetPrice
FROM [SLS].[Invoice] AS i
INNER JOIN [POS].[InvoiceItem] AS ii ON i.[InvoiceId] = ii.[InvoiceRef]
GROUP BY i.[InvoiceId], i.[Number], i.[CustomerRealName]
ORDER BY TotalItemNetPrice DESC, i.[InvoiceId] ASC
